description: This Java source file defines the utility class WidgetWorker, which provides static methods for constructing URIs, creating HTML elements, handling form elements, managing screen stacks, and retrieving context-specific data within the OFBiz widget framework.

classes.name: WidgetWorker
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for URI construction, HTML element creation, form handling, and context management within the OFBiz widget framework.

methods.name: buildHyperlinkUri
methods.description: Constructs a URI for a hyperlink based on target, type, parameters, and request context, including handling for intra-app, inter-app, and content URIs, as well as CSRF tokens.

methods.name: getContentUrl
methods.description: Generates a full content URL by prefixing with the content path and appending the specified location.

methods.name: makeHiddenFormLinkAnchorElement
methods.description: Creates an HTML anchor element (<a>) for submitting a hidden form via JavaScript, with optional confirmation and image inclusion.

methods.name: makeHiddenFormLinkFormElement
methods.description: Creates an HTML form element configured to submit hidden inputs to a target URI.

methods.name: makeLinkHiddenFormName
methods.description: Generates a unique name for a hidden form based on context, model form, and form item index.

methods.name: determineAutoLinkType
methods.description: Determines whether a link should be rendered as a hidden form or a simple anchor based on request mappings and target types.

methods.name: getScriptLocation
methods.description: Extracts the location part from a combined script name of the form 'location#methodName'.

methods.name: getScriptMethodName
methods.description: Extracts the method name from a script combined name 'location#methodName'.

methods.name: getScreenStack
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the ScreenStack object from the context.

methods.name: getJwtCallback
methods.description: Retrieves the JWT callback ID from the context or parameters.

methods.name: getPaginatorNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the current paginator number from the context, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: incrementPaginatorNumber
methods.description: Increments and updates the paginator number in the context.

methods.name: getDispatcher
methods.description: Returns the LocalDispatcher object from the context.

methods.name: getDelegator
methods.description: Returns the Delegator object from the context.

methods.name: resolveParametersMapFromQueryString
methods.description: Parses a special parameter string from context into a map of parameters.
